segments.he: לְבֵית הִלֵּל נָמֵי, אַף עַל גַּב דְּאָמְרִי תְּמוּרָה בְּטָעוּת הָוְיָא תְּמוּרָה — הָנֵי מִילֵּי הֵיכָא דְּאִיתֵיהּ לְעִיקַּר הֶקְדֵּשׁ. אֲבָל הֵיכָא דְּמִיתְעֲקַר עִיקַּר הֶקְדֵּשׁ — אִיתְעֲקַר נָמֵי תְּמוּרָה.
segments.en: Rabbi Yirmeya continues: «According to» the opinion of «Beit Hillel as well, even though» they «say» that «a substitution» of a consecrated animal for another performed «in error is» a valid «substitute, this applies» only «when the initial consecration,» i.e., the consecration of the first animal, «is» in effect, in which case a substitution can take place. «However,» in a situation «where the initial consecration has been uprooted,» i.e., a halakhic authority dissolved the vow pertaining to the first consecration, the first animal is no longer consecrated, and therefore the «substitute is also uprooted,» i.e., the animal remains non-sacred.

moves.summary: Completes the inference: even for Beit Hillel, the substitute falls with the uprooted consecration

positions.claim: according to Beit Hillel too, once the original consecration is uprooted, its substitute is uprooted
